title: Your first customer record: create, save and find it again
goal: Create a customer in your own training infobase, reopen the saved record and distinguish editing it from creating another.
prerequisites: Install official training 1C:Enterprise and create a separate empty file infobase. The lab guide covers these steps.
This lab needs no programming, Nexus Studio, source archive or Windows Sandbox. Its route includes preparing the simple catalog.
outcomes: Distinguish a catalog definition, its list of records and one customer’s item form.
Create «Учебный Север», save it and find it after reopening the infobase.
Rename that same customer, create a second and explain why equal descriptions can make identification difficult.
sections: Why a service desk needs a customer catalog

Imagine a dispatcher receiving service requests. Typing each customer name again invites spelling differences and accidental duplicates. A catalog lets you save a customer once and later select that record in requests. We are not creating requests yet: the small goal is a clear customer list with a record you can find after closing its window. All names in the exercise are fictional.

In 1C a catalog defines records of the same kind. Клиенты is the kind of data; «Учебный Север» is one particular catalog item. A developer defines the available properties in Designer. A user fills those properties for a particular item in 1C:Enterprise mode. Creating a catalog definition and entering a customer are therefore different activities in different modes.

A list form displays several customers; an item form, called a customer card in this lesson, displays one. Create (Создать) opens a new card. Double-clicking a saved row opens an existing one. This matters when correcting a name: selecting Create again starts another customer instead of correcting the saved record.

Our simple configuration has the standard Code (Код) and Description (Наименование) attributes. Description is text intended for people; enter «Учебный Север». Code helps distinguish rows. This lab uses automatic numbering, so leave the new code empty and inspect the value assigned when saving. Do not copy another record’s code or assume that every configuration uses the same numbering rules.

A visible field belongs to a form. An attribute is the data property whose value the field helps a user enter. For example, the Наименование field edits the Наименование attribute. The platform can generate forms for this simple catalog, so you need not design an entire window before entering the first record. A later lesson explains custom forms after you understand the user’s required actions.

Text visible in an open new card is not sufficient proof of durable saving. Choose Save and close (Записать и закрыть), wait for the list and check that a row appears. Open it again and inspect the value. Reopening distinguishes saved data from text that was merely displayed in an input. Do not close the entire application immediately after pressing Save without checking its result.
One record, a new description: avoid an accidental duplicate

A saved item has its own identity. A reference allows the application to point to that item; its displayed description is only a human-readable representation. Open the existing customer, change «Учебный Север» to «Учебный Север — ремонт» and save. You are editing the same card. In this lab confirm that its code is unchanged and no additional list row has appeared.

Create starts a different workflow: a new card becomes a separate record when saved. Calling it «Учебный Север» does not automatically combine it with another customer. Our simple training catalog deliberately does not enforce unique descriptions. Search and compare available attributes before adding a new customer. A real application’s duplicate detection rules are a separate design decision.

Similar row text alone cannot prove reference equality. For now use the observable difference: renaming an existing customer leaves one row with its previous code, whereas creating «Учебный Юг» adds a second row with its own code. Programming with references and documents comes later. This introductory lab requires no GUID inspection or service identifier processing.
An empty list, search and reopening

An empty visible list does not always mean data loss. You may have opened another catalog or infobase, or retained a search filter. After renaming a customer, searching for its complete old description may no longer match it. Clear the search and inspect the full list. Sorting changes row order; filters change visible membership. Neither action alone creates or deletes customers.

To check saving, close 1C:Enterprise mode and reopen the same training infobase from the launcher. Verify its displayed name and directory. Open Клиенты, clear search and find both rows. Reopen each card. If both descriptions and their separate codes are present, the reopening check has succeeded. Preserve a screenshot containing only the fictional training data.

Nexus provides the route and stores your own completion report. It does not see the external 1C window and cannot automatically confirm that your card appeared. Preserve the actual infobase and observations separately. Use the platform’s .dt dump for backup and another new infobase for restoration checks. Creating a copy must not replace the original training work.

walkthrough.action: Identify which action changes the application definition and which uses it.
walkthrough.expected: Define Клиенты in Designer; enter customer records in 1C:Enterprise.

walkthrough.action: Follow the route from an empty list to reopening «Учебный Север».
walkthrough.expected: One saved card; record its actual code in your notes.

walkthrough.action: Rename that customer and add «Учебный Юг».
walkthrough.expected: The first retains its code, the second has another; two rows appear in the full list.

examples.title: Worked example: a new card becomes a saved record
examples.source: Empty list → Создать → Наименование: Учебный Север → Записать и закрыть → reopen the saved row
examples.expected: One row appears; the reopened card contains «Учебный Север» and its assigned code.
examples.explanation: Before saving, you are editing a new card. After Save and close the row is available in the list. Reopening retrieves saved values rather than merely displaying the previous input.
trace: Use a new empty training infobase with search cleared.
No saved list record has yet been confirmed.
Text is visible in the field
Typing does not replace the save command.
Check that the saved card remains accessible.

examples.title: Edit an existing customer, then add a second
examples.source: Open Учебный Север → rename to Учебный Север — ремонт → save; then Создать → Учебный Юг → save
examples.expected: Renaming leaves one row; adding another customer produces two rows with separate codes.
examples.explanation: The first action edits the existing card; the second creates a separate record. Clear the search before comparing, because a filter can hide a row.

exercises.task: Create «Учебный Север» using the detailed route. Reopen its card from the list. Record its code and explain the observation that supports successful saving.
exercises.criteria: One list row and a reopened card with the correct description. Record the actual code assigned in your infobase, not a preselected value.
exercises.hint: Continue beyond typing: save, return to the list and reopen the result.

exercises.task: Rename the saved customer to «Учебный Север — ремонт», then create «Учебный Юг». Predict the row count before each action and compare it with the complete list.
exercises.criteria: Renaming leaves one row and its previous code; creating the second gives two rows with different codes.
exercises.hint: Opening a row edits that item; Create starts a separate record.

exercises.task: Create a third fictional customer «Учебный Восток». Close and reopen the same infobase. Find the customer and rename it to «Учебный Восток — выезд» without making a duplicate. Explain what to inspect if the row is not visible.
exercises.criteria: All three records remain after reopening. The third keeps its code when renamed. Explain infobase selection, catalog selection and search filters.
exercises.hint: Clearing search changes the visible list; it does not delete customers.

lab.title: The first customer in your training infobase
lab.environment: Primary workflow: normally installed official training 1C, a separate new file infobase, Designer only for preparation and 1C:Enterprise for customer cards. No code, Studio or Sandbox required.
steps: Open your separate empty training infobase in Designer.
If Клиенты does not exist, define it using the detailed step. Do not load a third-party configuration over your own work.
Start the application, open Клиенты and create and save «Учебный Север».
Reopen the saved card and check description and code. Rename it without selecting Create.
Create «Учебный Юг», clear search and compare both rows.
Reopen the same infobase and both cards; preserve the result and a separate backup.

In the customer-list search box enter “Несуществующий учебный клиент” (a deliberately nonexistent training name), then press Enter. Observe an empty list. Select the clear × at the right of the search box: both saved cards must reappear. Search hides rows; it does not delete records.
expected: Two separate customers with different codes are saved.
The first customer retains its code when renamed; reopening shows the saved values.
An empty result after Enter; Training North — repair and Training South return after clearing, with original codes 000000001 and 000000002 in this observed configuration.
evidence: Screenshots of the empty list, first card, two-customer list and reopened card.
Your observed codes and a brief explanation of editing an existing item versus creating another.
lab.negative: In the customer-list search box enter “Несуществующий учебный клиент” (a deliberately nonexistent training name), then press Enter. Observe an empty list. Select the clear × at the right of the search box: both saved cards must reappear. Search hides rows; it does not delete records.

mistakes: I selected Create to correct a name.
Cancel the unsaved new card. Double-click the existing row and edit it. If a duplicate was already saved, inspect which record you created; do not delete the original at random.
Clear the old search text. Inspect the full list, selected infobase and catalog.
I entered a name, closed the window and cannot find it.
Check whether Save and close was performed. Merely typing in a form does not prove a saved record.
I see an object tree rather than a customer list.
You are in Designer. After preparation start 1C:Enterprise mode, where customer records are entered.

quiz.question: Where do you enter a particular customer’s description in this lab?
options: In the Name property of the configuration object.
In a new catalog item card in 1C:Enterprise mode.
In the Nexus Studio course selector.
quiz.explanation: The Клиенты definition describes the application. A user enters «Учебный Север» in the item card.

quiz.question: How do you correct the description while keeping the existing record?
options: Open its row, edit the description, save and check that its previous code remains.
Choose Create and enter the corrected description.
quiz.explanation: Editing an existing card preserves its identity. Create starts another record.

quiz.question: After renaming, searching for the complete old description shows an empty list. What should you check first?
options: Whether the installed platform has stopped working.
Whether the whole configuration needs rebuilding.
Clear search, check the selected infobase and inspect the full list.
quiz.explanation: A filter can hide an existing record. Empty visible results do not prove data deletion.

review: Explain catalog, list and card in ordinary language.
Demonstrate renaming a customer and adding a different one.
Next: connect a request to a saved customer rather than retyping its name.

title.ru: От описания справочника к сохранённой карточке
title.en: From a catalog definition to a saved record

detail.ru: Описание в Конфигураторе определяет, какие сведения хранит элемент. Конкретных клиентов пока нет.
detail.en: The Designer definition specifies item properties. No particular customer has yet been entered.

detail.ru: Кнопка Создать открывает форму. Введённый текст ещё нужно записать.
detail.en: Create opens an item form. Entered text must still be saved.

detail.ru: Платформа сохраняет элемент; в списке появляется строка с наименованием и кодом.
detail.en: The platform saves the item; its description and code appear in the list.

detail.ru: Повторное открытие показывает сохранённые значения той же карточки.
detail.en: Reopening retrieves the saved values of that same card.

steps.title: Prepare your training infobase
steps.before: The training platform is installed and a separate empty file infobase «Учебная сервисная служба» exists.
steps.action: Select that infobase and choose Designer (Конфигуратор). If its tree is hidden, choose Configuration → Open configuration.
steps.why: Work only on your own training application.
steps.expected: The configuration tree is visible; this is not the customer entry window.
steps.troubleshooting: If the infobase contains previous work, use another empty infobase rather than replacing its configuration.

figures.caption: Open the configuration tree in Designer. This prepares the application; customer entry uses a different window.
figures.alt: Open the configuration tree in Designer. This prepares the application; customer entry uses a different window.

steps.title: Define the simple Клиенты catalog
steps.before: A new empty configuration is open. If Клиенты already exists in your training infobase, inspect its properties and skip creating it.
steps.action: Right-click Catalogs (Справочники) → Add (Добавить). On Main (Основные), set Name (Имя) to Клиенты and Synonym (Синоним) to Клиенты. On Data (Данные), check code length 9, String code type, description length 80 and automatic numbering enabled. Add no custom attributes or forms yet; close the properties window.
steps.why: Define the structure so the platform can provide standard list and item commands.
steps.expected: One Клиенты object appears under Catalogs; it is not yet the customer «Учебный Север».
steps.troubleshooting: If the name already exists, inspect that training object rather than creating Клиенты 2.

steps.title: Open the application and customer list
steps.before: Клиенты is defined and the infobase’s user application window is closed.
steps.action: Press Ctrl+S, then F7 to update the database configuration and confirm object creation if prompted. Press F5. In the application, find Клиенты; if no separate section exists, inspect Главное (Main). Open its list.
steps.why: Move from defining the application to entering its records.
steps.expected: The Клиенты list has a Create (Создать) command and is empty in a new infobase.
steps.troubleshooting: If Клиенты is missing, inspect the infobase name, F7 update and standard catalog commands in Designer. Do not enter customers in another catalog.

figures.caption: 1C:Enterprise: the empty Клиенты list. Create (Создать) is above the list on the left.
figures.alt: 1C:Enterprise: the empty Клиенты list. Create (Создать) is above the list on the left.

steps.title: Create and save the first card
steps.before: The Клиенты list is open with search cleared.
steps.action: Choose Create, enter «Учебный Север» in Наименование (Description), leave Code for automatic numbering, then choose Save and close (Записать и закрыть). Wait for the list.
steps.why: Turn the entered values into one saved record.
steps.expected: One row named «Учебный Север» appears with its code.
steps.troubleshooting: If the form stays open, read the platform message and inspect Description. Do not select Create again before resolving the first card.

figures.caption: New card: 1 — enter the description; 2 — select Save and close. This training catalog assigns the code automatically.
figures.alt: New card: 1 — enter the description; 2 — select Save and close. This training catalog assigns the code automatically.

figures.caption: Saving adds one row. Its code in this fresh infobase is 000000001; the actual code in your infobase can differ.
figures.alt: Saving adds one row. Its code in this fresh infobase is 000000001; the actual code in your infobase can differ.

steps.title: Reopen and rename the saved card
steps.before: The saved customer row is visible.
steps.action: Double-click the row, inspect its description and note its actual code. Rename it to «Учебный Север — ремонт», save and close. Clear search and compare row count and code.
steps.why: Check saved values and edit that same record.
steps.expected: One row has the new description and its original code.
steps.troubleshooting: Two rows may mean Create was used instead of editing. Compare their codes and preserve the observation without randomly deleting the original.

figures.caption: Reopening shows the saved description and assigned code. Edit this card rather than creating another.
figures.alt: Reopening shows the saved description and assigned code. Edit this card rather than creating another.

steps.title: Add another customer and reopen the infobase
steps.before: The first customer is saved and renamed.
steps.action: Create «Учебный Юг» using the same workflow. Clear search and check two rows with separate codes. Close the application, select the same infobase in the launcher and reopen 1C:Enterprise. Open Клиенты and both cards.
steps.why: Reopening checks that saved records remain accessible after closing.
steps.expected: Both cards remain available; the first has its changed description and unchanged code.
steps.troubleshooting: For an empty list, check infobase name and directory, then catalog and search. Nexus cannot automatically inspect the cause.

figures.caption: After closing and restarting, both customers remain. The first has a new description and its original 000000001 code; the second has 000000002.
figures.alt: After closing and restarting, both customers remain. The first has a new description and its original 000000001 code; the second has 000000002.

figures.caption: The same card after restart: «Учебный Север — ремонт» with its original code. This is the observed result of this experiment.
figures.alt: The same card after restart: «Учебный Север — ремонт» with its original code. This is the observed result of this experiment.

steps.title: An empty search result does not mean deletion
steps.before: Both training cards are saved and visible.
steps.action: In the customer-list search box enter “Несуществующий учебный клиент” (a deliberately nonexistent training name), then press Enter. Observe an empty list. Select the clear × at the right of the search box: both saved cards must reappear. Search hides rows; it does not delete records.
steps.why: Distinguish the visible list from records stored in the infobase.
steps.expected: An empty result after Enter; Training North — repair and Training South return after clearing, with original codes 000000001 and 000000002 in this observed configuration.
steps.troubleshooting: Use the search box inside the customer list, not global application search. If rows remain hidden, check active filters and the infobase name before attempting any data changes.

figures.caption: Search for a nonexistent name was applied with Enter.
figures.alt: Search for a nonexistent name was applied with Enter.

figures.caption: Both original rows reappear after Clear. No records were deleted.
figures.alt: Both original rows reappear after Clear. No records were deleted.
